name: search_experiences
description: Search live events, shows, classes, tours, markets and venues (restaurants, bars, museums, parks) in New York City. 2-4 seconds; 1 credit per search of up to 20 results. One search per direction (per interest, time slot or kind of place), several in parallel; pick `limit` per direction. Left to defaults: 10 results per type, both experiences and venues, every upcoming date, whole city, no filters. Each result is a short block: title, category, date and time, venue name and address, neighborhood, price, setting, vibe words, a one-line summary, the booking link, one image URL and an id for get_details. Choose from them for the user; do not relay them all.

query.description: One direction, as a short phrase describing what the user wants rather than repeating their sentence: 'live jazz', 'rooftop cocktails', 'kid-friendly science museum', 'lively group dinner'. Fold what you know about the user into the wording ('intimate', 'quiet', 'family-friendly', 'cheap'). Put the time in time_windows and the place in location, not here.

location.description: {"city": "New York"} for the whole city. Add "area_text" to narrow to a neighborhood or borough the user named: {"city": "New York", "area_text": "Williamsburg"}. If you have coordinates (the user's position, a hotel) use a circle instead: {"point": {"lat": 40.73, "lng": -73.99, "radius_km": 2}}; results then carry a distance. Never send both city and point.

city.description: "New York". NYC, Manhattan, Brooklyn and the other boroughs are accepted too. No other city is covered yet.

area_text.description: A neighborhood or borough, e.g. 'Williamsburg', 'Lower East Side', 'Queens'. Only with city. If it matches nothing the search widens to the whole city and the result says so.

point.description: Circle search around a coordinate; radius_km 0.1-50. Results carry distance_km.

time_windows.description: When the user could go: a list of {start, end} in New York local time, written like '2026-09-20T19:00', with no timezone and no 'Z'. One window per stretch of time. Tonight: one window 18:00-23:59 today. This weekend: two windows, Saturday and Sunday, each 00:00-23:59. Saturday evening: one window 17:00-23:59. Next week: one window from Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59. A window must end in the future. Omit only when the user has no time in mind; the search then covers every upcoming date.

result_types.description: ["experiences"] for things that happen at a time (a show, a class, a market, a tour); ["venues"] for places (a bar, a restaurant, a museum, a park). Pick one per direction. Omitted, both come back.

limit.description: Results for this search, per result type. Default 10. About 10 for a side interest, up to 20 for the direction the user cares most about; up to 20 still costs 1 credit.

is_free.description: true keeps only free experiences, false only paid ones. Rows with unknown price are left out either way. Use for a tight budget.

environment_types.description: Keep only experiences in these settings: indoor, outdoor, mixed. Use for weather.

ranking.description: Optional nudges, not sorts: prefer_popularity moves well-known things earlier, prefer_uniqueness unusual ones, prefer_credibility established ones. Leave out unless the user's taste points that way.

cursor.description: The cursor from a previous result, for the next page of the SAME search with every other argument unchanged. Nothing repeats and the order does not shift. Expires after 15 minutes; if expired, run the original search again without it.

name: get_details
description: Everything about one experience or venue the user asked about, by the id from a search result: full schedule, host, venue hours, amenities and phone, all images and every source link. Under 1 second, 1 credit. For a result the user picked, not for every row.

id.description: The id shown on a search result.

kind.description: experience for a row from the EXPERIENCES list, venue for one from VENUES.

name: list_supported_cities
description: The cities the catalogue covers and how many experiences and venues each holds, plus the category and vibe vocabularies. Free. Today only New York is stocked; call this if you need to check whether that has changed.
